segmentation.text: in an area designated as a school zone or school crossing zone
(a) When there are no children present;
(b) On a day on which school is not in session;
(c) During the period from a half hour after school is no longer in operation to a half hour before school is next in operation;
(d) If the zone is designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
during the hours when the pupils of the school are in class
and the yellow lights of the speed limit beacon are not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect;
or (e) If the zone is not designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
during the times when the sign designating the school zone or school crossing zone indicates that the speed limit is not in effect.

As used in this section, “speed limit beacon” means a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit in a school zone or school crossing zone is in effect.

elements.justification: 'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'), as the mapping index maps 'The driver of a vehicle'. 'The driver' (DEF-NRS-484A-080, 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle') is a role, read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

'U-turn' is defined by DEF-NRS-484B-077 ('the turning of a vehicle upon a highway so as to proceed in the opposite direction, whether accomplished by one continuous movement or not'), which the concept drv.motion.u_turn carries with that definition: the heading change over the recognition window within the reversal band, integrated across forward and backing moves.

An area designated as a school zone or school crossing zone is the stretch a dev.zone_sign of kind school or school_crossing ('a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road; kind ∈ {school, school_crossing, ...}') posts: the travel regions it governs (dev.governs) that x occupies (rel.occupies) of kind st.travel_region. The definitions (DEF-NRS-484B-063 'those sections of streets which are adjacent to school property', DEF-NRS-484B-060 'those sections of streets ... that pupils cross') describe legal region classes; the ontology reads the sign where the category is also marked on the road. Not a stand-in for whether the posted condition holds now, which prim.conditions_hold reads in exception (e).

Children present are road users of class ru.child ('pedestrian who is visibly a child') whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) the highway (st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders') that the zone's governed region lies on (st.on_way). Not a stand-in for the roadway: the whole way, sidewalks included, is where children are present in the zone.

A zone designated by a speed limit beacon is one where a dev.speed_limit_beacon ('a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign, flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect') governs (dev.governs) the travel region (st.travel_region) x occupies (rel.occupies). 'operational' is read as the beacon not being dev.inoperative ('a signal head installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication').

The yellow lights not flashing in the manner indicating the limit is in effect is the beacon's flashing attribute false: dev.speed_limit_beacon, 'flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect; flashing attribute'.
The zone is not designated by an operational beacon: no dev.speed_limit_beacon that is not dev.inoperative governs (dev.governs) a travel region x occupies (rel.occupies).

The sign designating the zone is the dev.zone_sign of kind school or school_crossing governing (dev.governs) the region x occupies; its 'conditions attribute: a structured reading of the sign's legend — a list of time windows ...' states when its speed limit is in effect, and the limit is not in effect where prim.conditions_hold ('the structured conditions of a device ... hold at the observation for a road user') is false.

The section's definition of a speed limit beacon ('a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately') is what dev.speed_limit_beacon denotes: 'a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign, flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect'.

assumptions.meaning: The school the zone serves is not in session on the day of the observation.
The observation falls in the period that begins a half hour after the school the zone serves last ceased operation and ends a half hour before it next begins operation.
The pupils of the school the zone serves are in class at the observation.

applicability: x is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle that makes a U-turn: drv.motion.u_turn(x) rises at the judged observation (window p.turn_recognition_window, angles p.reversal_min_angle and p.reversal_max_angle); at some observation while the U-turn is under way (in the window behind the recognition, where drv.motion.turning(x) with p.yaw_rate_tolerance) x occupies a travel region r governed by a dev.zone_sign z of kind school or school_crossing.
obligation: The U-turn is violated unless at every observation while it is under way (throughout) one of the exceptions holds, the same one at each: (a) no ru.child occupies the highway h that r lies on (st.on_way(r, h)); (b) asm.school_not_in_session; (c) asm.school_out_of_operation_period; (d) a dev.speed_limit_beacon b, not dev.inoperative, governs a travel region x occupies, and asm.pupils_in_class, and b's flashing attribute is false; (e) no such operational beacon governs a travel region x occupies, and prim.conditions_hold(z, x) is false. Where an exception's atom or assumption is not observed or not declared and no other exception decides, the verdict is unknown.

narrowings.why: 'The driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever is at the controls.
The designation of the area as a school zone or school crossing zone is read through the zone sign present on the road and the regions it governs; its official status is presumed from its presence.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car makes a U-turn in a lane governed by a school zone sign whose conditions hold, with children on the sidewalk of the same highway; school is declared in session and outside the half-hour margins, no speed limit beacon governs the lane.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same U-turn with no child anywhere on the highway throughout the U-turn.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car makes a U-turn on a street governed by no school zone or school crossing zone sign.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The forbid scene with the source unable to classify children: whether children are present is unknown and no other exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u3
scenarios.narrative: The U-turn starts outside the zone and its second half lies in a lane the school zone sign governs, all exceptions failing.

scenarios.name: occasion_u3_outside
scenarios.narrative: The car was in the zone only before the U-turn began and makes the whole U-turn after leaving the governed lanes.

scenarios.name: occasion_u5
scenarios.narrative: No child is present when the U-turn begins, a child steps onto the sidewalk halfway through; no other exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u5_outside
scenarios.narrative: Children leave the highway before the U-turn begins and none is present at any observation of the U-turn.

scenarios.name: occasion_u8
scenarios.narrative: An operational beacon governs only the lane of the first part of the U-turn, its lights dark, pupils in class; the rest of the U-turn lies in a lane no beacon governs, where the zone sign's conditions hold; no child exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u8_outside
scenarios.narrative: An operational beacon, dark, governs every lane the U-turn occupies, pupils in class, and governed none of the lanes the car occupied before it.

scenarios.name: occasion_u10
scenarios.narrative: Pupils in class, an operational beacon governs the lanes; its lights stop flashing halfway through the U-turn; no other exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u10_outside
scenarios.narrative: The beacon flashes before the U-turn and is dark at every observation of it, pupils in class.

scenarios.name: occasion_u11
scenarios.narrative: No beacon governs the lane of the first part of the U-turn, where the sign's conditions do not hold; an operational flashing beacon governs the lane of its second part; no other exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u11_outside
scenarios.narrative: No beacon governs any lane the U-turn occupies while one governed the lane the car occupied before it; the sign's conditions do not hold throughout the U-turn.

scenarios.name: occasion_u12
scenarios.narrative: No beacon; the zone sign's conditions stop holding only halfway through the U-turn; no other exception holds.

scenarios.name: occasion_u12_outside
scenarios.narrative: No beacon; the zone sign's conditions hold before the U-turn and fail at every observation of it.

under_way.justification: An observation inside the U-turn is one in the recognition window behind the observation the U-turn is recognized at where the heading is changing (drv.motion.turning, reading kin.yaw_rate above its resolution); before the U-turn began the heading did not change.

param_proposals.name: p.turn_recognition_window
param_proposals.convention: The time within which a turn or a reversal, a reversal made in several moves included, is completed: the window over which the heading change is recognized.
param_proposals.source: Observed durations of U-turns and multi-point turns.

param_proposals.name: p.reversal_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: The heading change magnitude from which the heading has come round to the opposite direction (a reversal); also the upper bound of a turn.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide).

param_proposals.name: p.reversal_max_angle
param_proposals.convention: The heading change magnitude beyond which the heading has come round past the opposite direction (a loop rather than a reversal).
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide).

param_proposals.name: p.yaw_rate_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Yaw-rate resolution: the noise floor of a source's yaw-rate estimate, below which a heading is read as not changing.
